constrained_cloze.contract: One visible sentence contains exactly one [[RESPONSE]] slot. The slot contains every overt form needed to evidence the target operations; the surrounding text must not reveal those forms.

dialogue_completion.contract: A concise, coherent dialogue makes one missing learner response pragmatically clear. Exactly one turn contains [[RESPONSE]].

multiple_choice.contract: Four meaning-matched options differ primarily in the target grammatical operations. Exactly one option is keyed; distractors must be plausible operation errors, not lexical or world-knowledge traps.

sentence_transformation.contract: A source sentence, explicit communicative instruction, and supplied lexical cue determine one target sentence without requiring an unprompted lexical substitution.
